column7: Bounds what an untrusted provider can put in the log and in the error a login ends with: only a listed RFC 6749 error code passes, any other text reads as other
Refuses an authorization code from another issuer before redeeming it (RFC 9207 issuer check, validate_issuer at its call here), on every login path: CLI, startup and the web UI
Says whether a sign-in was confirmed since this client last adopted from storage, so its cached token may be an older account; a mistake would keep sending the old credential

Takes the confirmed token from storage for a client holding an older one, sampling the install count before the read and recording it only after; a mistake would keep the old credential or lose a newer confirm
